name: What size guest home can I build on my property?

mainEntity.name: What size guest home can I build on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The maximum size of a guest home you can build is determined by local zoning ordinances and your property's characteristics. Regulations typically specify maximum square footage, often ranging from 800 to 1200 square feet, or a percentage of the primary dwelling's size. Setbacks from property lines and other structures also influence the usable footprint. We help assess your property's potential and design a guest home that maximizes space within regulatory limits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Guest home size is limited by local zoning laws, typically ranging from 800 to 1200 square feet or a percentage of the main home's size, and influenced by setbacks.
